mil3.5.4:0.3: 4. The Question on Seeing the Truth
mil3.5.4:1.2: “Sir Nagasena, you have seen the Dhamma”.
mil3.5.4:1.3: “Through the transmission of the Buddha, Great King, the Dhamma laid down by the Buddha is to be lived by his disciples for their whole life”.
mil3.5.4:3.1: The Question on Seeing the Truth, fourth.
